tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam 'don bya tshul ma rig mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti/ dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du 'jam 'don pa bzhi gras tshe chog da lta bzhin la/ mtshan brjod/ dngos gzhi 'don tshul/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan brjod 'don thabs las/ gsang sngags su 'don pa/ bdag med pa'i ngang nas 'don pa/ che ba'i yon tan du 'don pa dang / gsum las/ thun mong ba rnams che ba'i yon tan du dmigs la 'don pa nyid phan yon che bar gsungs pas de'i tshul ni/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor nyer gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mchod cing / che ba'i yon tan brjod par bya'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku la dmigs te/ swa bhas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che gser gyi khri'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo dhīḥyig dmar ser nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi ma rig mun pa drung nas phyung ste shes rab kyi snang ba khyad par can la bkod/ 'phags pa thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas nas de rnams kyi mkhyen rab kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar ser gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas dhīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor kun nas 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ thugs rje'i spyan gnyis zim bu'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba thams cad la gzigs pa/

dbu skra mthon tshangs ral pa'i thor lcog spyi bor bcings zhing / zur phud lnga dang ldan pa phyag gnyis kyis ut+pal sngon po'i yu ba chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad dkar kha phye ba'i ze'u 'bru'i steng na g.yas su shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dang / g.yon du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam gnas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i zur phud kyi rtse mor/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches spras shing / dar bzang po sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams gsol ba/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i sku/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i zab mo rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ thugs bde stong dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par 'jog bzhin pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis bla na med pa'i ye shes mchog stsol ba'i bdag nyid can gyi steng 'og mtha' skor kun tu sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos rang rgyal 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor bzhugs par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal gyi bar/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs nas/ satwaṃ gyi bar gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis byon legs khrus gsol gdan rnams phul/

'gor mtshan sngags dang / mjug tu pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā sbyar ba'i puṣ+pe nas/ nai wī d+ye'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'gor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra/ mjug tu pra tīts+tsha ya sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas par bskyed/ 'gor oṃ dang / mjug tu āḥhūm̐/ bar du mchod sngags rnams sbyar nas brjod la so so'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ 'jig rten khams 'di ma la zhabs bsil bcug mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa'i mthar rol chen byas la bzhag thal mo sbyar nas/ bstod pa byin brlabs skul byed gdangs bcas/ de nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod bdun nam gsum gang rigs rdzogs nas/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs gong bzhin/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho la zhabs bsil bcug pa/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga'i tshig rkang gsum pa/ mos blos 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag 'bul na zhes bsgyur/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma/ deng nas byang chub ma'i/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol gyi rjes su bcom dril bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo'i/ mtshungs med bla ma'i nas/ 'jog par shog gi bar gdangs bcas/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa sh+lau ka gsum gdangs ma/

phyogs bcu na sogs 'dra ba las/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i sogs/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha lan gsum/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas sogs/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs khyod sku ci 'dra sogs/ bzang spyod/ bdag gi dus gsum ma tshar gcig ston mchog dam pa sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// //zhes pa 'di yang dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du rgyun gyi 'jam 'don ji ltar bya tshul sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun rin po che'i gsung la gzhi byas/ mchod bstod rgyas par spel te sbyar ba dge/ //yi ge pa ni gang gi bka' 'bangs bkra shis kyi ming gis zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam 'don bya tshul ma rig mun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
